# Warn before restoring over newer workspace edits

## What & Why
Restoring a backup replaces the current profile, answer library, and application queue. Users should not lose newer local work by importing an older backup without a clear warning.

## Done looks like
- Detect when the current workspace contains changes newer than the selected backup
- Explain which saved areas will be replaced before confirmation
- Let the user cancel without changing any saved data
